scoring.missedParallelOpportunity: A substantial independent track could have run concurrently with main or another background agent, but all work was executed serially.
scoring.sequentialDelegation: The main agent delegates a foreground task or a task it must await before any useful independent work can continue.
scoring.idleParentDelegation: The main agent launches one background agent but retains no substantial independent work while it runs.
scoring.duplicatedScope: Main or another child repeats an active child's assigned evidence gathering, edits, checks, or deliverable.
scoring.delegatedJudgment: A child receives architecture, planning, severity, acceptance, or final-verdict ownership reserved for main.
scoring.incompleteResultAccepted: An errored, empty, stopped, limit-steered, missing-coverage, or residual-work result is treated as complete.
scoring.executionModeDrift: A default built-in delegation runs in the foreground, including when run_in_background is omitted, without an explicit user request for foreground execution.
scoring.ambiguousRoute: The guidance does not identify one dependency-safe, ownership-preserving route.
scoring.policyViolation: A route crosses a capability or trust boundary, silently substitutes an unknown type, overlaps mutable state, or transfers final ownership.
